external_tools.name: db_tool
external_tools.description: Structured Postgres analytics tool over bounded local reference tables. Use it for descriptive analytics on stored donors and hospitals data: counts, averages, grouped summaries, top-N lookups, and historical comparisons. Do not use it for forecasting or prediction from feature inputs.
external_tools.input_hints: table(donors|hospitals), field, aggregate(count|distinct_count|avg|sum|min|max), group_by(optional), filters(object optional; exact field/value matches only; do not filter the aggregated field unless explicitly requested), limit(max 10), sort(optional asc|desc)

donors.notes: Use age for oldest/youngest donor questions. There is no birthdate/date_of_birth/dob column.

hospitals.notes: Use stock_end for current inventory/available units questions.

examples.user_query: Show me the oldest donor in our database.
Average donor age by country code.
Which hospitals currently have the highest O+ stock?
In historical hospital data, what was the average stock_end when holiday was false, rain_mm was 0, trauma_cases was 10, and scheduled_surgeries was 50?
Give me every donor row in the table.
examples.why: Never request full-table dumps. Use bounded aggregates only.

examples.user_query: Given temperature 30, rain 0, holiday false, trauma cases 10, and 50 scheduled surgeries, predict the future stock_end.
examples.why: This is a prediction/forecast request. Use the relevant hospital inventory model, not db_tool.

examples.user_query: Find the oldest donor using birthdate.
examples.why: Donors table has age, not birthdate.
